label: TP
reason: Both alerts represent genuine vulnerabilities. Alert 1 (java/xss): User input from request headers flows through param -> valuesList -> bar -> fileName and reaches the HTML output sink at lines 74-75 via encodeForHTML. While encoding is applied, the balanced rule indicates attacker-controlled data reaching the sink warrants TP. Alert 2 (java/path-injection): Same user input flows to fileName at line 71 via TESTFILES_DIR + bar, enabling path traversal (e.g., ../../../etc/passwd). Both sinks receive attacker-controlled data.

evidence.note: User input from headers flows through param, added to valuesList, remove(0) shifts indices, get(1) retrieves user input into bar
fileName combines TESTFILES_DIR with bar containing user input, creating XSS sink at print statement and path injection sink
